assistant.heading: Your assistant
assistant.description: Name, avatar and personality are used everywhere in the app and in how the assistant replies. Private to you: stored on this computer and follows your GitHub account when signed in (kept across computers). Teammates — managers included — can't see it and have their own assistant.
assistant.name: Assistant name
assistant.customPlaceholder: e.g. like an encouraging older sibling who jokes a little

claude.heading: AI connection
claude.description: Choose how the assistant runs. Everyone uses their own account or key.

support.heading: Support
support.description: Hit a bug? Send a report with the app version and recent log (personal info masked) so the team can fix it.

claude-cli.name: Claude Code CLI (recommended)
claude-cli.description: Uses your Claude Pro/Max plan through Claude Code signed in on this computer.

anthropic-api.name: Anthropic API key (fallback)
anthropic-api.description: Uses an API key you create on Claude Console; usage is billed to your own account.

ai.invalidKey: Invalid key format (should start with sk-ant-).
ai.noSecureStorage: This computer has no secure storage, so the API key cannot be saved.
ai.keyHelp: The key is encrypted, stays on this computer, and is only ever sent to Anthropic.
ai.getKey: Create a key on Claude Console
ai.autoSuggestHelp: When you leave a chat with 2+ new messages, the assistant suggests what to remember (uses one extra AI call). You still review before saving.
